rows.step: Go with Ralof; train Two-Handed to 40 on him while wearing heavy armor
rows.notes: Free early Heavy Armor and Two-Handed levels.

rows.step: Loot both Imperials; grab the lockpicks from the prison area
rows.notes: Imperial armor sells for more.

rows.step: Take the Thief Stone
rows.notes: +20% to Alchemy and Speech.

rows.step: Collect Mora Tapinella along the road; buy a pickaxe in Riverwood
Detour to the Ritual Stone for the Undying Ghost spell
rows.notes: Does your fighting until crafting is done.

rows.step: Join the Companions (the joining fight only)
rows.notes: Required for Eorlund's Smithing training.

rows.step: Cart to Morthal; clear Myrwatch with Undying Ghost (fire on the seal)
rows.notes: Loot Heart Stones, potions, and a Bear Pelt for a backpack.

rows.step: Take the 2 unenchanted staffs; keep them unenchanted
rows.notes: Saved for the Bloodchill staff enchanter.

rows.step: Plant 7 Mora Tapinella, 2 Scaly Pholiota, 1 Creep Cluster; wait 24 hours
rows.notes: Myrwatch garden.

rows.step: Sell Myrwatch loot to ~500 gold; buy the wild horse map (250); take the red horse NW of the stables
rows.notes: Whiterun.

rows.step: Clear Goldenhills (Undying Ghost + Flames) and finish the quest; mine stone for the Exterior Decoration
rows.notes: Goldenhills Plantation.

rows.step: Plant 20 Mora Tapinella, 12 Creep Cluster, 12 Scaly Pholiota; wait 3 days; harvest 250–300 of each
rows.notes: Carry 150 of each, store the rest.

rows.step: Cart to Windhelm; pick Snowberries by the stable; do Sadri's ring quest (save before breaking in)
rows.notes: Snowberries are for Fortify Enchanting later.

rows.step: Get Well Rested
Alchemist 1/5
rows.notes: Take before your first brew.

rows.step: Brew Creep Cluster + Mora Tapinella + Scaly Pholiota at the White Phial
rows.notes: Windhelm.

rows.step: Alchemist 2/5
Physician
Benefactor
rows.notes: Raises the value of beneficial potions.

rows.step: Alchemist 3/5
Sell potions; buy Speech training from Revyn Sadri
rows.notes: Sadri's Used Wares.

rows.step: Haggling 1/5
Allure
Merchant
rows.notes: Sell anything to any merchant.

rows.step: Buy Smithing training from Eorlund, selling potions between sessions
rows.notes: Skyforge, Whiterun. Keep buying it as you level for the rest of the plan.

rows.step: Brew more and buy Alchemy training until Alchemy 60
rows.notes: Arcadia's Cauldron.

rows.step: Alchemist 4/5
Alchemy 60 · Speech 50 · Smithing rising from training · 9 perks taken
Buy Courage from Farengar; switch to the Mage Stone
rows.notes: Dragonsreach; Guardian Stones.

rows.step: Take the Bloodworm Helm from Gallows Hall; catch vampirism in Mara's Eye Den; wait 3 days
rows.notes: Mara's Eye Pond.

rows.step: Cart to Dawnstar; let the vampires clear Bloodchill Cavern; sleep for Well Rested
rows.notes: Bloodchill Manor becomes your house. No Solstheim before the next step.

rows.step: Enchant both Myrwatch staffs at the staff enchanter
rows.notes: Mage Stone + Well Rested active. About 65 Enchanting.

rows.step: Enchanting ~65
Enchanter 1/5
Enchanter 2/5
Enchanter 3/5
Enchanter 4/5
Insightful Enchanter
rows.notes: Take before the Fortify Alchemy set: skill enchantments on armor are 25% stronger.

rows.step: Craft and enchant a batch of iron daggers to push Enchanting past 70
rows.notes: Lets you take Corpus Enchanter early.

rows.step: Buy Stoneflower Petals or Dreugh Wax, plus any Gold Kanet
rows.notes: Khajiit caravan outside Whiterun or Markarth.

rows.step: Solitude: buy a hat, gloves, and a Fortify Alchemy item to disenchant; coin to a beggar; Blessing of Zenithar
rows.notes: Radiant Raiment; Temple of the Divines.

rows.step: Buy a ring and necklace from Madesi; buy 4 filled Grand Soul Gems from Farengar
rows.notes: Riften; Dragonsreach.

rows.step: Take the Thief Stone; brew Snowberries + Wax/Petals for Fortify Enchanting
Wear the Bloodworm Helm, drink Fortify Enchanting, enchant hat, gloves, ring, necklace with Fortify Alchemy
rows.notes: Vampire + helm: the potion is 25% stronger.

rows.step: Wear the set; brew the rest of the farm ingredients
Alchemist 5/5
Alchemy 100 · Smithing training maxed (90) · 15 perks taken
Steel Smithing
Dwarven Smithing
Orcish Smithing
Ebony Smithing
rows.notes: Needed to forge the Ebony Bows.

rows.step: Switch to the Warrior Stone; buy all Iron, Dwarven, Orichalcum and Ebony ingots
rows.notes: Blacksmiths.

rows.step: Make iron daggers, Dwarven Bows and Ebony Bows
rows.notes: Any forge.

rows.step: Smithing 100
Switch to the Mage Stone; enchant all the weapons
rows.notes: Arcane enchanter.

rows.step: Corpus Enchanter
rows.notes: Requires Insightful Enchanter.

rows.step: Enchanter 5/5
Enchanting 100
Extra Effect
rows.notes: Two enchantments per item. Requires Corpus Enchanter.

rows.step: Brew Fortify Smithing (Blisterwort + Gold Kanet) and Fortify Enchanting potions
rows.notes: Blisterwort from Arcadia's Cauldron. Wear the helm when you drink them.

rows.step: Enchant a combined Alchemy/Smithing set (both effects on each piece)
rows.notes: Uses Extra Effect.

rows.step: Drink Fortify Smithing; forge and improve an Ebony armor set and weapon; drink Fortify Enchanting and enchant them
rows.notes: Your first end-game gear, made at 100 in all three skills.

rows.step: Speed craft session done: Alchemy, Smithing, Enchanting 100 · 22 perks
Cure vampirism
rows.notes: Falion in Morthal; he asks for a filled black soul gem. You lose the Bloodworm Helm's 25% boost, so do it once you're done making potions and enchantments.

Alchemy 100 · Smithing training maxed (90) · 15 perks taken
Steel Smithing
Elven Smithing
Advanced Armors
rows.notes: Requires Elven Smithing.

rows.step: Glass Smithing
rows.notes: Requires Advanced Armors. Needed to forge Glass gear.

rows.step: Switch to the Warrior Stone; buy all Iron ingots, Refined Moonstone and Refined Malachite
rows.notes: Blacksmiths. Moonstone is for Elven gear, Malachite for Glass.

rows.step: Make iron daggers, then Elven and Glass weapons
rows.notes: Any forge. Higher-value items give more XP, so Glass gives the most per item.

rows.step: Smithing 100
Switch to the Mage Stone; enchant all the weapons
rows.notes: Arcane enchanter.

rows.notes: Requires Insightful Enchanter.

Cure vampirism

rows.step: Go with Ralof; loot both Imperials; grab the lockpicks from the prison area
rows.notes: No armor training needed. All the armor is sale loot.

rows.step: Take the Thief Stone
rows.notes: +20% to Alchemy and Speech.

rows.step: Collect Mora Tapinella along the road; buy a pickaxe in Riverwood
rows.notes: The pickaxe is for Goldenhills stone and the Halted Stream iron veins.

rows.step: Detour to the Ritual Stone for the Undying Ghost spell
rows.notes: Your combat until the build is done. No Companions stop: you won't need Eorlund's training.

rows.step: Cart to Morthal; clear Myrwatch with Undying Ghost (fire on the seal)
rows.notes: Loot Heart Stones, potions, and a Bear Pelt for a backpack.

rows.step: Take the 2 unenchanted staffs; keep them unenchanted
rows.notes: Saved for the Bloodchill staff enchanter.

rows.step: Plant 7 Mora Tapinella, 2 Scaly Pholiota, 1 Creep Cluster; wait 24 hours
rows.notes: Myrwatch garden.

rows.step: Sell Myrwatch loot to ~500 gold; buy the wild horse map (250); take the red horse NW of the stables
rows.notes: Whiterun.

rows.step: Clear Halted Stream Camp with Undying Ghost; take the Transmute Mineral Ore tome
rows.notes: North of Whiterun. The tome is on the table at the back of the mine.

rows.step: Mine every iron ore vein in the mine
rows.notes: 16+ veins. Keep the ore: it becomes your gold supply.

rows.step: Clear Goldenhills (Undying Ghost + Flames) and finish the quest; mine stone for the Exterior Decoration
rows.notes: Goldenhills Plantation.

rows.step: Plant 20 Mora Tapinella, 12 Creep Cluster, 12 Scaly Pholiota; wait 3 days; harvest 250–300 of each
rows.notes: Carry 150 of each, store the rest. Cast Transmute on your ore while you wait: it levels Alteration.

rows.step: Cart to Windhelm; pick Snowberries by the stable; do Sadri's ring quest (save before breaking in)
rows.notes: Snowberries are for Fortify Enchanting later.

Alchemist 1/5
rows.notes: Take before your first brew.

rows.notes: Windhelm.

Allure
Merchant
rows.notes: Sell anything to any merchant.

rows.step: Buy all the iron ore from every blacksmith you pass from here on
rows.notes: Iron ore is cheap; Transmute turns it into gold.

rows.step: Brew more and buy Alchemy training until Alchemy 60
rows.notes: Arcadia's Cauldron.

rows.step: Alchemist 4/5
Alchemy 60 · Speech 50 · 9 perks taken
Buy Courage from Farengar; switch to the Mage Stone
rows.notes: Dragonsreach; Guardian Stones.

rows.notes: Mage Stone + Well Rested active. About 65 Enchanting.

rows.step: Enchanting ~65
Enchanter 1/5
Enchanter 2/5
Enchanter 3/5
Enchanter 4/5
Insightful Enchanter
rows.notes: Skill enchantments on armor are 25% stronger: boosts both the Alchemy set and your school's Fortify gear.

rows.step: Buy Stoneflower Petals or Dreugh Wax
rows.notes: Khajiit caravan outside Whiterun or Markarth.

rows.step: Solitude: buy a hat, gloves, a Fortify Alchemy item to disenchant, and unenchanted robes; coin to a beggar; Blessing of Zenithar
rows.notes: Radiant Raiment; Temple of the Divines. The robes are for your final mage set.

rows.step: Solitude: buy Soul Trap
rows.notes: Sybille Stentor, Blue Palace. Fills your own gems for the jewelry enchanting, and levels Conjuration.

rows.step: Transmute iron ore → silver → gold; smelt it; forge a gold ring and a gold necklace
rows.notes: Any smelter and forge. No Smithing perks needed for jewelry. Replaces buying them from Madesi.

rows.step: Buy 4 filled Grand Soul Gems from Farengar
rows.notes: Dragonsreach.

rows.step: Take the Thief Stone; brew Snowberries + Wax/Petals for Fortify Enchanting
Wear the Bloodworm Helm, drink Fortify Enchanting, enchant hat, gloves, ring, necklace with Fortify Alchemy
rows.notes: Vampire + helm: the potion is 25% stronger.

rows.step: Wear the set; brew the rest of the farm ingredients
Alchemist 5/5
Alchemy 100 · 15 perks taken
Buy or loot apparel with your school's Fortify enchantment (and Fortify Magicka / Magicka Regen); disenchant each
rows.notes: You can't enchant an effect you haven't learned. Apparel effects also give more XP than weapon effects.

rows.step: Transmute all your iron ore to gold; smelt into gold ingots
rows.notes: Levels Alteration as you go.

rows.step: Forge gold rings in bulk (2 per ingot); add gems when you have them
rows.notes: Levels Smithing unperked; value-based XP makes gem jewelry the biggest jumps. No Smithing perks taken.

rows.step: Buy petty and lesser soul gems from Farengar; fill extras with Soul Trap
rows.notes: One gem per ring.

rows.step: Switch to the Mage Stone and get Well Rested; enchant every ring and sell them
rows.notes: Enchanted rings sell for more than plain ones. Repeat steps 50–53 until Enchanting 100.

rows.step: Corpus Enchanter
rows.notes: Requires Insightful Enchanter. Makes Magicka enchantments on armor 25% stronger.

rows.step: Enchanter 5/5
Enchanting 100
Extra Effect
rows.notes: Two enchantments per item. Requires Corpus Enchanter.

rows.step: Forge a fresh ring and necklace for the mage set (gem versions if you have them)
rows.notes: The gems only add sale value; enchantment strength doesn't depend on the item.

rows.step: Brew a stronger Fortify Enchanting potion while wearing the Alchemy set
rows.notes: Higher Alchemy + the set makes a stronger potion than the first one.

rows.step: Wear the Bloodworm Helm, drink the potion, and enchant robes, hood, ring and necklace with your school's Fortify enchantment plus a second Magicka effect
rows.notes: Aim for 100% spell cost reduction in your main school.

rows.step: Speed craft session done: Alchemy 100, Enchanting 100, Speech 50, Smithing raised without perks · 18 perks
rows.notes: 4 fewer perks than the Heavy/Light plans. Spend those on your main magic school. Alteration also got a head start from Transmute.

rows.step: Cure vampirism
rows.notes: Falion in Morthal; he asks for a filled black soul gem. You lose the helm's 25% boost. Mages may prefer to stay a vampire and take Necromage at Restoration 70 instead.
